target.name: EGFR (human, wild-type)
target.assay_filter: binding activities (assay_type=B), standard values converted to pIC50

gate.truth_active_rule: median published pIC50 >= 6.0 (IC50 <= 1 uM, HTS hit bar)

blinding: All compounds below are REMOVED from everything the loop can see: candidate library, surrogate training pool, replay-lab truth. Their published measurements exist in the frozen corpus (proving the removal worked) and are used only in the reveal/scoring step.
honest_limits: The corpus is wild-type EGFR potency. The clinical futures of lapatinib (HER2) and osimertinib (T790M selectivity) turn on selectivity axes this target slice cannot see; a WT-potency-only prospective test can only judge the potency claim, and says so.
ReplayLab plates synthesize the curve SHAPE (Hill response) around the published median IC50; the IC50 is the real measured quantity, the wells are replay with a declared seeded noise model.
Multi-assay medians mix assay formats (biochemical vs cell); medians are used as truth precisely because single-assay values are format-bound — the spread is reported per compound.

ChEMBL documents are not blinded by DATE here: the loop may know the whole published literature around every chemotype EXCEPT the seven held-out molecules themselves. This tests structure-level blinding, not time travel.
